title: Slippery and Bouncy
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about gravity as a tool. Ice drags Kit along and they slide on after they let go, a belt carries them down its length, a spring pad bounces them up and a fan's wind lifts them through a ledge. Each level has one spike to learn from. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a pull.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has three short levels to cross, and every block in them can pull. Ice drags them and they slide on, a belt carries them, a spring pad bounces them and a fan's wind lifts them up through a ledge. Read the signs, mind the spikes, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a pull.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Ice, a belt, a spring and wind: a block's pull is one setting
Made to be copied and taken apart
